pages.quiz:
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

13. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — 100 °C

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.

3. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. D — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. D — Ice melting to water

6. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. B — Glucose and oxygen

9. C — Producers

10. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.

11. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

12. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

13. A — newton (N)

14. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.
